en: The image is a black-and-white nighttime photograph of a monument with several statues. The inscription on the monument includes Italian text, and the lower border of the postcard gives the details: '42 - Trento - Monumenti a Dante e Cesare Battisti (Notturno)'. The statue appears to feature multiple figures in dramatic poses, illuminated against a dark background.
